nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Zoom calls this URL. Raw Body is on because Zoom signs the exact bytes it sends, and the signature check needs them.

nodes.name: Read Raw Body
nodes.notes: Keeps the raw request body next to the parsed one for the signature check.

nodes.name: Webhook Secret
nodes.notes: Reads the Event Subscription secret token from the Data table 'Zoom Recaps - Webhook Secret' (column secretToken). The value lives in n8n only, never in this file.

nodes.name: Verify Zoom
nodes.notes: Answers Zoom's URL validation with the HMAC of its challenge, and requires a valid x-zm-signature on every other call (401 otherwise). Decides the reply; does not post.

nodes.name: Respond to Zoom
nodes.notes: Sends Verify Zoom's answer back to Zoom right away, inside Zoom's 3 second limit.

nodes.name: Summary Completed?
nodes.notes: Only a meeting.summary_completed event with a valid signature goes on.

nodes.name: Configured Meeting?
nodes.notes: Only a meeting listed in the Config Data table goes on.

nodes.name: Let Summary Settle
nodes.notes: Waits 40 minutes so Zoom finishes refining the summary (it rewrites it about 20 minutes after creating it) and the Gate's 15 minute cooldown has passed, then joins the same posting path as the daily sweep.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-opus-5", max_tokens: 2000, output_config: { effort: "low" }, messages: [ { role: "user", content: "You are preparing a meeting recap to post in the InnerSource Commons team Slack. InnerSource Commons (ISC) is a nonprofit foundation. Keep ONLY content about InnerSource Commons organizational business - for example: the InnerSource Summit, sponsors and sponsorships, the board, staff and hiring, membership, community calls and events, marketing and the newsletter, programs, partnerships, and ISC finances or operations. Remove everything that is not ISC business, even if it sounds professional - for example an attendee's own side business, venture, or consulting; their personal job search, interviews, offers, or career moves; other employers or former jobs; personal legal, financial, or family matters; and any health, social, or off-topic chit-chat. Do not summarize or reference the removed topics at all. Do not add, infer, or invent anything - keep only what is actually present and clearly ISC-related. When you are unsure whether something is ISC business, leave it out. Preserve each next step's 'Name: task' prefix. If nothing in the summary is ISC-related, return an empty recap and an empty nextSteps array. Return ONLY a JSON object of the form {\"recap\": string, \"nextSteps\": string[]}. " + ($json.chathamHouse ? "This meeting is held under the Chatham House Rule, so ANONYMIZE it completely: share what was discussed and decided, but never reveal who said or did anything, or who attended. Remove every person's name (full names, first names, nicknames, possessives) and every participant's employer, company, or organizational affiliation (for example a company name tied to what a participant said, demoed, or works on). Refer to people only as 'a participant', 'one attendee', 'several participants', or 'the group'. Also leave out any detail specific enough to identify a speaker indirectly - a job title, their employer's named product or internal system, or their personal circumstances. For nextSteps, keep each step's leading 'Name:' owner prefix exactly as given (it is replaced with an anonymous label before posting), but remove every name and affiliation from the task text after the prefix. " : "") + "Here is the summary to filter:\n" + JSON.stringify({ recap: $json.recap, nextSteps: $json.nextSteps }) } ] }) }}
